defect: C17 Mc histogram bin assignment differed from NumPy at decimal boundaries.
root_cause: NumPy arange uses an effective binary64 step derived from (start + step) - start. The C17 code used direct division plus epsilon.
fix: Use NumPy-compatible effective edges and edge-based binary search.
full_run_instruction: Run make real-catalog-parity locally before release 1.0.1.
